title: Add Open WebUI for Pollinations to chat
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Open WebUI for Pollinations](https://openwebui.pollinations.ai) to chat
- Open WebUI chat frontend with Pollinations login. All Pollinations text models in the picker, plus the Pollinations MCP server as a tool server for image, video and audio.

Fixes #14416

gist.headline: The chat garden gets windows
gist.blurb: Open WebUI has joined the Pollinations chat patch. Sign in with Pollinations, pick from the full text-model shelf, and hand image, video, or audio jobs to the MCP tool server.
gist.summary: Added Open WebUI for Pollinations at openwebui.pollinations.ai, with Pollinations login, every Pollinations text model in its picker, and the Pollinations MCP server available for image, video, and audio tools.
gist.impact: People can now use a full Open WebUI chat workspace with Pollinations authentication and model access, then generate media without leaving the conversation.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Open WebUI as a welcoming retro chat terminal with several tidy model-choice tabs and small tool icons for image, video, and audio. Polli, wearing tiny librarian glasses, hovers beside the monitor and helps the eager CRT Monitor Robot connect colorful code-vines from the chat window to a small garden of media-producing plants.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art hackerspace garden where a chunky retro chat monitor labeled "OPEN WEBUI" shows a friendly model picker and tiny image, video, and audio tool icons; glowing code-vines run from the screen into flower pots. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears tiny librarian glasses and warmly helps a cute CRT-monitor robot plug the chat terminal into the garden. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, subtle CRT glow and scanlines, nostalgic but beautiful.
